acceptance: All coverage and quality criteria required; review band means revise on development, never automatic acceptance. Missing coverage or wide CI means unresolved.
revision_rule: After opening validation, any change to method or threshold needs new revision and fresh unopened validation roots. Final thresholds frozen before that evaluation; confirmatory never used for tuning.
limitations: These engineering targets are design choices, not values given by the specification or evidence of measurement validity. No significance test or scientific effect size is fixed here.
